timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Ever gazed at the night sky and wondered about the mysteries it holds?
What if we told you that a significant portion of the universe is made up of something we can't even see?
The universe is vast and filled with wonders.
One of its biggest mysteries is dark matter.
While we can't see it directly, scientists believe it makes up about 27% of the universe.
Its presence is inferred by its gravitational effects on visible matter.
But what exactly is it? Why can't we see it?
What do you think dark matter could be?
Dive deeper into the cosmos with us.
Like, follow, and stay tuned for more mysteries.
